meta.title: Upon The Ruins
meta.description: The flames of war fill the sky, and echoes linger over the rubble.

units.rawText: I don't like this darkness.
units.displayText: I don't like this darkness.

spans.text: I don't like this darkness.

units.rawText: The beeping of instruments, the humming of the bed, and the familiar sound of footsteps and sheets of paper rustling against each other.
units.displayText: The beeping of instruments, the humming of the bed, and the familiar sound of footsteps and sheets of paper rustling against each other.

spans.text: The beeping of instruments, the humming of the bed, and the familiar sound of footsteps and sheets of paper rustling against each other.

units.rawText: These sounds... Am I home?
units.displayText: These sounds... Am I home?

spans.text: These sounds... Am I home?

units.rawText: Old man, are you there?
units.displayText: Old man, are you there?

spans.text: Old man, are you there?

units.rawText: Welcome back, Zangyin.
units.displayText: Welcome back, Zangyin.

spans.text: Welcome back, Zangyin.

units.rawText: So I really did come home... Then you should have told me earlier. It scared the hell out of me.
units.displayText: So I really did come home... Then you should have told me earlier. It scared the hell out of me.

spans.text: So I really did come home... Then you should have told me earlier. It scared the hell out of me.

units.rawText: But when did I arrive home? I don't remember at all... Why haven't my visual modules started up yet?
units.displayText: But when did I arrive home? I don't remember at all... Why haven't my visual modules started up yet?

spans.text: But when did I arrive home? I don't remember at all... Why haven't my visual modules started up yet?

units.rawText: Your visual modules have been damaged. My assistant is getting replacements for you.
units.displayText: Your visual modules have been damaged. My assistant is getting replacements for you.

spans.text: Your visual modules have been damaged. My assistant is getting replacements for you.

units.rawText: The person who sent you back said you were hit by a human firearm.
units.displayText: The person who sent you back said you were hit by a human firearm.

spans.text: The person who sent you back said you were hit by a human firearm.

units.rawText: A gun? I guess I got caught up in the fighting after all... And I lost some of my memories too... Humph, as expected.
units.displayText: A gun? I guess I got caught up in the fighting after all... And I lost some of my memories too... Humph, as expected.

spans.text: A gun? I guess I got caught up in the fighting after all... And I lost some of my memories too... Humph, as expected.

units.rawText: I told you before, we can't fight, so it's very dangerous to go into combat zones!
units.displayText: I told you before, we can't fight, so it's very dangerous to go into combat zones!

spans.text: I told you before, we can't fight, so it's very dangerous to go into combat zones!

units.rawText: Sorry, Zangyin. However, the data you brought back is very precious.
units.displayText: Sorry, Zangyin. However, the data you brought back is very precious.

spans.text: Sorry, Zangyin. However, the data you brought back is very precious.

units.rawText: An old yet strong palm places itself on my head and gently rubs it. I like that feeling very much.
units.displayText: An old yet strong palm places itself on my head and gently rubs it. I like that feeling very much.

spans.text: An old yet strong palm places itself on my head and gently rubs it. I like that feeling very much.

units.rawText: Humph, don't expect me to forgive you without a couple of sticks of grilled fish, and they've got to be the best kind, grilled mackerels!
units.displayText: Humph, don't expect me to forgive you without a couple of sticks of grilled fish, and they've got to be the best kind, grilled mackerels!

spans.text: Humph, don't expect me to forgive you without a couple of sticks of grilled fish, and they've got to be the best kind, grilled mackerels!

units.rawText: Hehe, I'll have my assistant fetch some grilled mackerels for you as well.
units.displayText: Hehe, I'll have my assistant fetch some grilled mackerels for you as well.

spans.text: Hehe, I'll have my assistant fetch some grilled mackerels for you as well.

units.rawText: That's more like it. I'll wait here a little longer, then.
units.displayText: That's more like it. I'll wait here a little longer, then.

spans.text: That's more like it. I'll wait here a little longer, then.

units.rawText: You need to rest.
units.displayText: You need to rest.

spans.text: You need to rest.

units.rawText: The mirth in his voice fades, and at the same time I can hear the sounds of clothing fasteners closing and buttons sliding into holes.
units.displayText: The mirth in his voice fades, and at the same time I can hear the sounds of clothing fasteners closing and buttons sliding into holes.

spans.text: The mirth in his voice fades, and at the same time I can hear the sounds of clothing fasteners closing and buttons sliding into holes.

units.rawText: The noises are a little slow and tired. They're nowhere as crisp and quick as what they sounded like whenever I helped him dress and get his things on before we went out together in the past.
units.displayText: The noises are a little slow and tired. They're nowhere as crisp and quick as what they sounded like whenever I helped him dress and get his things on before we went out together in the past.

spans.text: The noises are a little slow and tired. They're nowhere as crisp and quick as what they sounded like whenever I helped him dress and get his things on before we went out together in the past.

units.rawText: ...Wait a minute. You're going out? Right now?
units.displayText: ...Wait a minute. You're going out? Right now?

spans.text: ...Wait a minute. You're going out? Right now?

units.rawText: The flames of war will swallow up everything, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.
units.displayText: The flames of war will swallow up everything, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.

spans.text: The flames of war will swallow up everything, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.

units.rawText: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.
units.displayText: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.

spans.text: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.

units.rawText: Hey, am I hearing things? You're going into a war zone at your age? Weren't you the one who told me "a virtuous man doesn't stand next to a wall that's about to collapse!?"
units.displayText: Hey, am I hearing things? You're going into a war zone at your age? Weren't you the one who told me "a virtuous man doesn't stand next to a wall that's about to collapse!?"

spans.text: Hey, am I hearing things? You're going into a war zone at your age? Weren't you the one who told me "a virtuous man doesn't stand next to a wall that's about to collapse!?"

units.rawText: Wait. Don't go. Please don't go.
units.displayText: Wait. Don't go. Please don't go.

spans.text: Wait. Don't go. Please don't go.

units.rawText: Listen to my assistant.
units.displayText: Listen to my assistant.

spans.text: Listen to my assistant.

units.rawText: Old man, you mustn't go!
units.displayText: Old man, you mustn't go!

spans.text: Old man, you mustn't go!

units.rawText: ...Can't you at least wait until I'm better?! If anything happens to you, I won't be able to save you.
units.displayText: ...Can't you at least wait until I'm better?! If anything happens to you, I won't be able to save you.

spans.text: ...Can't you at least wait until I'm better?! If anything happens to you, I won't be able to save you.

units.rawText: You'll get hurt! Ricochets will punch through your spine! Little Si won't be able to help you when I'm lying here!
units.displayText: You'll get hurt! Ricochets will punch through your spine! Little Si won't be able to help you when I'm lying here!

spans.text: You'll get hurt! Ricochets will punch through your spine! Little Si won't be able to help you when I'm lying here!

units.rawText: Nonsense, I'll be back with something tasty.
units.displayText: Nonsense, I'll be back with something tasty.

spans.text: Nonsense, I'll be back with something tasty.

units.rawText: You're so old already, so why are you so intent on doing something like this? Why won't you listen to me?
units.displayText: You're so old already, so why are you so intent on doing something like this? Why won't you listen to me?

spans.text: You're so old already, so why are you so intent on doing something like this? Why won't you listen to me?

units.rawText: Are you going to throw your life away to collect data? I don't get it... Is it worth it? Is it really worth it?
units.displayText: Are you going to throw your life away to collect data? I don't get it... Is it worth it? Is it really worth it?

spans.text: Are you going to throw your life away to collect data? I don't get it... Is it worth it? Is it really worth it?

units.rawText: My angry shouts echo only in my mind. Amidst the silence of reality, the door closes with a creak.
units.displayText: My angry shouts echo only in my mind. Amidst the silence of reality, the door closes with a creak.

spans.text: My angry shouts echo only in my mind. Amidst the silence of reality, the door closes with a creak.

units.rawText: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]
units.displayText: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]

spans.text: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]

units.rawText: Move! Stop blocking my way... This damned darkness!
units.displayText: Move! Stop blocking my way... This damned darkness!

spans.text: Move! Stop blocking my way... This damned darkness!

units.rawText: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]
units.displayText: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]

spans.text: [Warning: Activity restricted. Chassis damage at 42%. Calling for aid is recommended.]

units.rawText: Let me see... Let me move!
units.displayText: Let me see... Let me move!

spans.text: Let me see... Let me move!

units.rawText: Let me ask you why you're going into such dangerous territory, even though you know the risks...
units.displayText: Let me ask you why you're going into such dangerous territory, even though you know the risks...

spans.text: Let me ask you why you're going into such dangerous territory, even though you know the risks...

units.rawText: Suddenly, the darkness before me is pulled away by someone. The memories that have been called up recede like the tide, and new information floods into my processor module.
units.displayText: Suddenly, the darkness before me is pulled away by someone. The memories that have been called up recede like the tide, and new information floods into my processor module.

spans.text: Suddenly, the darkness before me is pulled away by someone. The memories that have been called up recede like the tide, and new information floods into my processor module.

units.rawText: ...Looks like I had a not-so-pleasant dream.
units.displayText: ...Looks like I had a not-so-pleasant dream.

spans.text: ...Looks like I had a not-so-pleasant dream.

units.rawText: Where... am I?
units.displayText: Where... am I?

spans.text: Where... am I?

units.rawText: Target reactivation complete. Vocal systems are fine.
units.displayText: Target reactivation complete. Vocal systems are fine.

spans.text: Target reactivation complete. Vocal systems are fine.

units.rawText: State your name and sector of origin.
units.displayText: State your name and sector of origin.

spans.text: State your name and sector of origin.

units.rawText: An icy-cold male voice speaks from above. Zangyin realizes that there is something pressed against her head.
units.displayText: An icy-cold male voice speaks from above. Zangyin realizes that there is something pressed against her head.

spans.text: An icy-cold male voice speaks from above. Zangyin realizes that there is something pressed against her head.

units.rawText: ...I'm Zangyin. My origin... My origin is... the Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: ...I'm Zangyin. My origin... My origin is... the Cloud Sector.

spans.text: ...I'm Zangyin. My origin... My origin is... the Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Good. Your logic circuits are functioning normally. You may get up.
units.displayText: Good. Your logic circuits are functioning normally. You may get up.

spans.text: Good. Your logic circuits are functioning normally. You may get up.

units.rawText: Zangyin props herself up and looks around.
units.displayText: Zangyin props herself up and looks around.

spans.text: Zangyin props herself up and looks around.

units.rawText: She is surrounded by post-battle ruins, and she is currently lying in a sunken region among these ruins.
units.displayText: She is surrounded by post-battle ruins, and she is currently lying in a sunken region among these ruins.

spans.text: She is surrounded by post-battle ruins, and she is currently lying in a sunken region among these ruins.

units.rawText: ...I remember now. I entered this sector and before I found the Sector Administrator, something blew me up...
units.displayText: ...I remember now. I entered this sector and before I found the Sector Administrator, something blew me up...

spans.text: ...I remember now. I entered this sector and before I found the Sector Administrator, something blew me up...

units.rawText: Where is this place?
units.displayText: Where is this place?

spans.text: Where is this place?

units.rawText: This is the Cyclopes Sector. Can you stand?
units.displayText: This is the Cyclopes Sector. Can you stand?

spans.text: This is the Cyclopes Sector. Can you stand?

units.rawText: Assuming your visual modules aren't defective, you should know that my leg is pinned.
units.displayText: Assuming your visual modules aren't defective, you should know that my leg is pinned.

spans.text: Assuming your visual modules aren't defective, you should know that my leg is pinned.

units.rawText: Any agent could easily get free of this kind of weight.
units.displayText: Any agent could easily get free of this kind of weight.

spans.text: Any agent could easily get free of this kind of weight.

units.rawText: I hope you will refine your phrasing. Only the Cyclopes Sector's agents could regard such a big chunk of solidified operands as nothing more than a chunk of cream wafer.
units.displayText: I hope you will refine your phrasing. Only the Cyclopes Sector's agents could regard such a big chunk of solidified operands as nothing more than a chunk of cream wafer.

spans.text: I hope you will refine your phrasing. Only the Cyclopes Sector's agents could regard such a big chunk of solidified operands as nothing more than a chunk of cream wafer.

units.rawText: Typically speaking, an agent cannot leave their sector of origin.
units.displayText: Typically speaking, an agent cannot leave their sector of origin.

spans.text: Typically speaking, an agent cannot leave their sector of origin.

units.rawText: Before we discuss the rules, could I trouble you to exert those dainty hands of yours to help move this piece of rubble away?
units.displayText: Before we discuss the rules, could I trouble you to exert those dainty hands of yours to help move this piece of rubble away?

spans.text: Before we discuss the rules, could I trouble you to exert those dainty hands of yours to help move this piece of rubble away?

units.rawText: The red-haired agent looks at her and then moves the debris away.
units.displayText: The red-haired agent looks at her and then moves the debris away.

spans.text: The red-haired agent looks at her and then moves the debris away.

units.rawText: So, what's going on? Does it rain bombs from the sky here?
units.displayText: So, what's going on? Does it rain bombs from the sky here?

spans.text: So, what's going on? Does it rain bombs from the sky here?

units.rawText: You were unlucky. A Greater Sanctifier's attack swept through this area and the buildings were destroyed.
units.displayText: You were unlucky. A Greater Sanctifier's attack swept through this area and the buildings were destroyed.

spans.text: You were unlucky. A Greater Sanctifier's attack swept through this area and the buildings were destroyed.

units.rawText: We're rebuilding the sector now, which was how we found you pinned under the rubble.
units.displayText: We're rebuilding the sector now, which was how we found you pinned under the rubble.

spans.text: We're rebuilding the sector now, which was how we found you pinned under the rubble.

units.rawText: Were you fighting that Greater Sanctifier?
units.displayText: Were you fighting that Greater Sanctifier?

spans.text: Were you fighting that Greater Sanctifier?

units.rawText: No, we were fighting with our friends. Someone else was fighting the Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: No, we were fighting with our friends. Someone else was fighting the Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: No, we were fighting with our friends. Someone else was fighting the Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Cyclopes really is a military sector after all. You're all so eager for a fight that you'll even throw down with a Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Cyclopes really is a military sector after all. You're all so eager for a fight that you'll even throw down with a Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: Cyclopes really is a military sector after all. You're all so eager for a fight that you'll even throw down with a Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Zangyin rises and checks herself.
units.displayText: Zangyin rises and checks herself.

spans.text: Zangyin rises and checks herself.

units.rawText: (I'm not too badly damaged; it's mainly been limited to my clothing and some operand holes from my injuries. Compared to that...)
units.displayText: I'm not too badly damaged; it's mainly been limited to my clothing and some operand holes from my injuries. Compared to that...

spans.text: I'm not too badly damaged; it's mainly been limited to my clothing and some operand holes from my injuries. Compared to that...

units.rawText: Hey, did you see a snake beside me when you found me?
units.displayText: Hey, did you see a snake beside me when you found me?

spans.text: Hey, did you see a snake beside me when you found me?

units.rawText: You know, the very small and very cute kind?
units.displayText: You know, the very small and very cute kind?

spans.text: You know, the very small and very cute kind?

units.rawText: As she gesticulates in the air, Zangyin engages the appropriate cognitive modules.
units.displayText: As she gesticulates in the air, Zangyin engages the appropriate cognitive modules.

spans.text: As she gesticulates in the air, Zangyin engages the appropriate cognitive modules.

units.rawText: [Agent accessory detected. Damage level at 89%, forced hibernation mode has been engaged.]
units.displayText: [Agent accessory detected. Damage level at 89%, forced hibernation mode has been engaged.]

spans.text: [Agent accessory detected. Damage level at 89%, forced hibernation mode has been engaged.]

units.rawText: Well, that's terrible. Even if I could fix you, your memory data would probably be gone. Looks like I'll have to tell you a long, long story again.
units.displayText: Well, that's terrible. Even if I could fix you, your memory data would probably be gone. Looks like I'll have to tell you a long, long story again.

spans.text: Well, that's terrible. Even if I could fix you, your memory data would probably be gone. Looks like I'll have to tell you a long, long story again.

units.rawText: You were the only agent nearby that survived. Whatever you plan to do, I advise you to leave this area ASAP.
units.displayText: You were the only agent nearby that survived. Whatever you plan to do, I advise you to leave this area ASAP.

spans.text: You were the only agent nearby that survived. Whatever you plan to do, I advise you to leave this area ASAP.

units.rawText: So the fighting hasn't finished yet?
units.displayText: So the fighting hasn't finished yet?

spans.text: So the fighting hasn't finished yet?

units.rawText: The fighting could resume at any moment.
units.displayText: The fighting could resume at any moment.

spans.text: The fighting could resume at any moment.

units.rawText: Zangyin looks in the direction where this unfamiliar agent is looking. The stories that were once told in this sector have all been buried under the ruins.
units.displayText: Zangyin looks in the direction where this unfamiliar agent is looking. The stories that were once told in this sector have all been buried under the ruins.

spans.text: Zangyin looks in the direction where this unfamiliar agent is looking. The stories that were once told in this sector have all been buried under the ruins.

units.rawText: The flames of war will swallow up all traces, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.
units.displayText: The flames of war will swallow up all traces, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.

spans.text: The flames of war will swallow up all traces, and the debris and history of the minor tribes will be wiped away in the same stroke.

units.rawText: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.
units.displayText: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.

spans.text: You still need time to recover, but those traces can't wait, so I need to collect and preserve the last vestiges of their data.

units.rawText: (The battlefield... A place being rebuilt... This scenery is so familiar, just like the place Professor Teng went...)
units.displayText: The battlefield... A place being rebuilt... This scenery is so familiar, just like the place Professor Teng went...

spans.text: The battlefield... A place being rebuilt... This scenery is so familiar, just like the place Professor Teng went...

units.rawText: (Is this the kind of place the old man was so bent on going to?)
units.displayText: Is this the kind of place the old man was so bent on going to?

spans.text: Is this the kind of place the old man was so bent on going to?

units.rawText: Enough spacing out. Now that you know the situation, you should hurry up and leave.
units.displayText: Enough spacing out. Now that you know the situation, you should hurry up and leave.

spans.text: Enough spacing out. Now that you know the situation, you should hurry up and leave.

units.rawText: Wait...!
units.displayText: Wait...!

spans.text: Wait...!

units.rawText: What is it? What else is there?
units.displayText: What is it? What else is there?

spans.text: What is it? What else is there?

units.rawText: Zangyin is briefly at a loss for words as she sees the suspicious look in the agent's eyes. The words she is about to speak catch in her throat, and it startles her.
units.displayText: Zangyin is briefly at a loss for words as she sees the suspicious look in the agent's eyes. The words she is about to speak catch in her throat, and it startles her.

spans.text: Zangyin is briefly at a loss for words as she sees the suspicious look in the agent's eyes. The words she is about to speak catch in her throat, and it startles her.

units.rawText: ...I need to stay here for a bit.
units.displayText: ...I need to stay here for a bit.

spans.text: ...I need to stay here for a bit.

units.rawText: A puzzled expression crosses the agent's face.
units.displayText: A puzzled expression crosses the agent's face.

spans.text: A puzzled expression crosses the agent's face.

units.rawText: Why do you need to stay here?
units.displayText: Why do you need to stay here?

spans.text: Why do you need to stay here?

units.rawText: (Why do I need to stay here?)
units.displayText: Why do I need to stay here?

spans.text: Why do I need to stay here?

units.rawText: However, Zangyin's neural cloud is in chaos having just awoken from hibernation.
units.displayText: However, Zangyin's neural cloud is in chaos having just awoken from hibernation.

spans.text: However, Zangyin's neural cloud is in chaos having just awoken from hibernation.

units.rawText: (Collecting post-battle data? Ensuring my own safety? Or...)
units.displayText: Collecting post-battle data? Ensuring my own safety? Or...

spans.text: Collecting post-battle data? Ensuring my own safety? Or...

units.rawText: Um... My snake, no, my friend's been destroyed, but its neural cloud data is still intact, so I need to find a new carrier for it, right?
units.displayText: Um... My snake, no, my friend's been destroyed, but its neural cloud data is still intact, so I need to find a new carrier for it, right?

spans.text: Um... My snake, no, my friend's been destroyed, but its neural cloud data is still intact, so I need to find a new carrier for it, right?

units.rawText: Zangyin tries her best to conjure up a reason to stay from her confused situation. It isn't very convincing, but she soon recovers her forthright and determined demeanor — verbal negotiations are her forte.
units.displayText: Zangyin tries her best to conjure up a reason to stay from her confused situation. It isn't very convincing, but she soon recovers her forthright and determined demeanor — verbal negotiations are her forte.

spans.text: Zangyin tries her best to conjure up a reason to stay from her confused situation. It isn't very convincing, but she soon recovers her forthright and determined demeanor — verbal negotiations are her forte.

units.rawText: It's an important friend of mine and a guarantor of my safety. If I leave now, who will protect me if I run into trouble again? Are YOU going to do it?
units.displayText: It's an important friend of mine and a guarantor of my safety. If I leave now, who will protect me if I run into trouble again? Are YOU going to do it?

spans.text: It's an important friend of mine and a guarantor of my safety. If I leave now, who will protect me if I run into trouble again? Are YOU going to do it?

units.rawText: You may have a request you want to make, but the Cyclopes Sector cannot meet it at the moment.
units.displayText: You may have a request you want to make, but the Cyclopes Sector cannot meet it at the moment.

spans.text: You may have a request you want to make, but the Cyclopes Sector cannot meet it at the moment.

units.rawText: Aw, don't be such a stick in the mud. Look at it this way, if I stay behind, I'll be able to contribute to your efforts in some way. A win-win is the best way!
units.displayText: Aw, don't be such a stick in the mud. Look at it this way, if I stay behind, I'll be able to contribute to your efforts in some way. A win-win is the best way!

spans.text: Aw, don't be such a stick in the mud. Look at it this way, if I stay behind, I'll be able to contribute to your efforts in some way. A win-win is the best way!

units.rawText: There's no need for that.
units.displayText: There's no need for that.

spans.text: There's no need for that.

units.rawText: What about your battles, then? I mean, if you're going up against Sanctifiers, an extra hand would help, right?
units.displayText: What about your battles, then? I mean, if you're going up against Sanctifiers, an extra hand would help, right?

spans.text: What about your battles, then? I mean, if you're going up against Sanctifiers, an extra hand would help, right?

units.rawText: ...I doubt a Doll who can't even protect herself would be of any help in a fight.
units.displayText: ...I doubt a Doll who can't even protect herself would be of any help in a fight.

spans.text: ...I doubt a Doll who can't even protect herself would be of any help in a fight.

units.rawText: Isn't there an assistant system? Or maybe I could store Code Signatures? Isn't there something I can do?
units.displayText: Isn't there an assistant system? Or maybe I could store Code Signatures? Isn't there something I can do?

spans.text: Isn't there an assistant system? Or maybe I could store Code Signatures? Isn't there something I can do?

units.rawText: I mean, surely I can be a legal visitor, right?
units.displayText: I mean, surely I can be a legal visitor, right?

spans.text: I mean, surely I can be a legal visitor, right?

units.rawText: After being pestered by Zangyin for so long, a crack finally appears on the agent's blank expression.
units.displayText: After being pestered by Zangyin for so long, a crack finally appears on the agent's blank expression.

spans.text: After being pestered by Zangyin for so long, a crack finally appears on the agent's blank expression.

units.rawText: You are not an agent of Cyclopes. You'd be better off elsewhere.
units.displayText: You are not an agent of Cyclopes. You'd be better off elsewhere.

spans.text: You are not an agent of Cyclopes. You'd be better off elsewhere.

units.rawText: Better off in another place?
units.displayText: Better off in another place?

spans.text: Better off in another place?

units.rawText: It just so happens that we have a way to communicate with them. Come with me.
units.displayText: It just so happens that we have a way to communicate with them. Come with me.

spans.text: It just so happens that we have a way to communicate with them. Come with me.

units.rawText: Zangyin lifts up her skirts and steps carefully out of the rubble and onto the intact, flat road.
units.displayText: Zangyin lifts up her skirts and steps carefully out of the rubble and onto the intact, flat road.

spans.text: Zangyin lifts up her skirts and steps carefully out of the rubble and onto the intact, flat road.

units.rawText: The agent walks onward without saying anything. The somber atmosphere following a battle seems to take physical form, weighing down on Zangyin's sensory systems.
units.displayText: The agent walks onward without saying anything. The somber atmosphere following a battle seems to take physical form, weighing down on Zangyin's sensory systems.

spans.text: The agent walks onward without saying anything. The somber atmosphere following a battle seems to take physical form, weighing down on Zangyin's sensory systems.

units.rawText: Even an agent can't escape the seriousness of war, can they?
units.displayText: Even an agent can't escape the seriousness of war, can they?

spans.text: Even an agent can't escape the seriousness of war, can they?

units.rawText: Seriousness?
units.displayText: Seriousness?

spans.text: Seriousness?

units.rawText: Seriousness. Nobody's smiling and everyone moves like they are seeking the highest efficiency possible.
units.displayText: Seriousness. Nobody's smiling and everyone moves like they are seeking the highest efficiency possible.

spans.text: Seriousness. Nobody's smiling and everyone moves like they are seeking the highest efficiency possible.

units.rawText: It's like how survival is the only thing in a world at war.
units.displayText: It's like how survival is the only thing in a world at war.

spans.text: It's like how survival is the only thing in a world at war.

units.rawText: That is our purpose.
units.displayText: That is our purpose.

spans.text: That is our purpose.

units.rawText: To fight, and then to live on. I know that.
units.displayText: To fight, and then to live on. I know that.

spans.text: To fight, and then to live on. I know that.

units.rawText: Are you not going to question our purpose?
units.displayText: Are you not going to question our purpose?

spans.text: Are you not going to question our purpose?

units.rawText: Dolls and Resident Agents are the same. We both act to fulfill the purposes the humans gave us.
units.displayText: Dolls and Resident Agents are the same. We both act to fulfill the purposes the humans gave us.

spans.text: Dolls and Resident Agents are the same. We both act to fulfill the purposes the humans gave us.

units.rawText: If I wanted to complain about the unreasonable things in the world, there'd be too many of them to work through. Ultimately, it's just that our aims are different.
units.displayText: If I wanted to complain about the unreasonable things in the world, there'd be too many of them to work through. Ultimately, it's just that our aims are different.

spans.text: If I wanted to complain about the unreasonable things in the world, there'd be too many of them to work through. Ultimately, it's just that our aims are different.

units.rawText: For instance, I don't understand why someone would insist on going somewhere to preserve the cultural information of a place, even if they knew that doing so would be very dangerous.
units.displayText: For instance, I don't understand why someone would insist on going somewhere to preserve the cultural information of a place, even if they knew that doing so would be very dangerous.

spans.text: For instance, I don't understand why someone would insist on going somewhere to preserve the cultural information of a place, even if they knew that doing so would be very dangerous.

units.rawText: There is no question that you are a Doll from that place.
units.displayText: There is no question that you are a Doll from that place.

spans.text: There is no question that you are a Doll from that place.

units.rawText: What place?
units.displayText: What place?

spans.text: What place?

units.rawText: We're here.
units.displayText: We're here.

spans.text: We're here.

units.rawText: The red-haired agent comes to a halt and Zangyin looks ahead.
units.displayText: The red-haired agent comes to a halt and Zangyin looks ahead.

spans.text: The red-haired agent comes to a halt and Zangyin looks ahead.

units.rawText: The ruins of a wall snake out into the distance. It seems the wall that once stood here divided the sector in two.
units.displayText: The ruins of a wall snake out into the distance. It seems the wall that once stood here divided the sector in two.

spans.text: The ruins of a wall snake out into the distance. It seems the wall that once stood here divided the sector in two.

units.rawText: Although it's been demolished, its remains are as glaring as stitches after a surgery.
units.displayText: Although it's been demolished, its remains are as glaring as stitches after a surgery.

spans.text: Although it's been demolished, its remains are as glaring as stitches after a surgery.

units.rawText: And in the midst of this wreckage stands a single, intact building, in stark contrast to its surroundings.
units.displayText: And in the midst of this wreckage stands a single, intact building, in stark contrast to its surroundings.

spans.text: And in the midst of this wreckage stands a single, intact building, in stark contrast to its surroundings.

units.rawText: Is this... a bar?
units.displayText: Is this... a bar?

spans.text: Is this... a bar?

units.rawText: The agent pushes the door open and leads Zangyin inside.
units.displayText: The agent pushes the door open and leads Zangyin inside.

spans.text: The agent pushes the door open and leads Zangyin inside.

units.rawText: Gin, I've brought an agent from your Sector.
units.displayText: Gin, I've brought an agent from your Sector.

spans.text: Gin, I've brought an agent from your Sector.

units.rawText: Thank you, Nameless.
units.displayText: Thank you, Nameless.

spans.text: Thank you, Nameless.

units.rawText: The blond Doll stands behind the counter before bowing briefly to Zangyin and the red-haired agent.
units.displayText: The blond Doll stands behind the counter before bowing briefly to Zangyin and the red-haired agent.

spans.text: The blond Doll stands behind the counter before bowing briefly to Zangyin and the red-haired agent.

units.rawText: Greetings. I am Gin, the Oasis' supporter in the Cyclopes Sector.
units.displayText: Greetings. I am Gin, the Oasis' supporter in the Cyclopes Sector.

spans.text: Greetings. I am Gin, the Oasis' supporter in the Cyclopes Sector.
